column1: 22521§chew§tʃuː§v. 咀嚼；咬§Rats like to chew on something hard.§老鼠喜欢咀嚼硬物。
22522§speculate§ˈspekjuleɪt§v. 推测；投机§I began to speculate about how she was spending her time.§我开始猜测她是如何打发时光的。

22523§bulge§bʌldʒ§n./v. 膨胀；凸出；塞满§In early May, the northern flank of the mountain bulged, and the summit rose by 500 feet, which indicated that the volcano would erupt.§五月初，火山的北侧山脊隆起，最高峰升高了500英尺，这预示着它即将喷发。
22524§insignificant§ˌɪnsɪgˈnɪfɪkənt§adj. 无关紧要的，无意义的§The consequences are insignificant compared to this great idea.§同这种伟大的思想相比，结果并不重要。
22525§revise§rɪˈvaɪz§v. 修订；复习§Teaching methodology should be constantly revised to keep the pace with the time.§教师应该不断调整教学方法以跟上时代发展的步伐。
22526§deposit§dɪˈpɒzɪt§v. 存放；储蓄；使沉淀；付（保证金） n. 存款；保证金，押金；沉积物§Overseas students must pay a deposit when they apply for a course at the college.§外国学生如果申请这所大学的课程，需要付一定的押金。

22527§professional§prəˈfeʃənl§adj. 职业的；专业的n. 专家；专业人员§Sports psychologists spend time with professional athletes helping them approach competition with a positive mental attitude.§运动心理学家花时间帮助职业运动员以一种积极的心态去迎接挑战。
22528§rigid§ˈrɪdʒɪd§adj. 严格的，死板的；刚硬的，僵硬的§Although glass is comparatively rigid, the atoms are arranged in a random disordered fashion.§虽然玻璃相对较硬，但是其分子结构排序杂乱无章。
22529§solemn§ˈsɒləm§adj. 庄严的，隆重的；严肃的，认真的§Kit made a solemn vow that he would always stand beside me.§基特郑重起誓，说他将永远支持我。
22530§outsell§ˌaʊtˈsel§vt. 卖得比…多§This kind of digital camera outsells all others on the market.§这款数码相机在市场上较其他型号更畅销。

22531§forum§ˈfɔːrəm§n. 论坛；讨论会§The huge development in rocket technology is a good thing, but at the same time, rockets cause devastating results in the forum of war.§火箭研制技术的长足进步是件好事，但同时火箭被用于战争也带来了惨痛的结果。
22532§anecdote§ˈænɪkdəʊt§n. 短故事；趣闻，轶事§In the historical lessons, the teacher quoted many anecdotes to attract students' attention.§在历史课上，老师借用大量的趣闻轶事来吸引学生的注意力。
22533§conversely§ˈkɒnvɜːsli§adv. 相反地，颠倒地§Conversely, achievements in applied science and technology often play a direct stimulus to the development of pure science.§相反，应用科学技术的成果通常可以直接促进纯科学的发展。

22534§prefabricate§priːˈfæbrɪˌkeɪt§vt. 预先制造，预制构件（用以组装建筑物、船舶等）§If implanting subcutaneous blood vessel to superficial fascia, thin transferable axial pattern skin flaps can be prefabricated.§如果将皮下组织血管移位至浅筋膜，可预制可转换的薄轴型皮瓣。
22535§paralysis§pəˈræləsɪs§n. 瘫痪；麻痹；中风§The doctor injects the patient to paralysis before the medical operation, to lower the pain.§在做手术之前，医生通常会给病人注射麻醉剂，来减轻疼痛。
22536§geometric§ˌdʒiːəˈmetrɪk§adj. 几何的；几何学的§He indulged in the study on geometric configuration even though he felt tired of math.§他虽然不喜欢数学，但却对研究几何构型充满兴趣。
22537§floral§ˈflɔːrəl§adj. 花的，像花的；绘有花的，饰以花的；植物群的§He devoted much time to floral design in his study room, with the inspiration from a cartoon.§他花费了很多时间对书房进行花饰设计，创作灵感源于一幅漫画。
22538§pollinate§ˈpɒləneɪt§vt.【植】给…授粉§A well-known scientist recently reported that air pollution may prevent bees from finding flowers to pollinate.§一位著名科学家最近提出，空气污染可能会妨碍蜜蜂找到花进行授粉。

22539§objectify§əbˈdʒektɪfaɪ§vt. 使客观化；使具体化；物化§It is so pervasive a dimension that it is difficult to objectify in spatial terms and difficult to consider apart from oneself.§作为一个虚无缥缈的维度，很难在空间的范畴内使它具象化，也很难脱离它进行思考。
22540§presuppose§ˌpriːsəˈpəʊz§vt. 预先假定…属实；认为，假设；以…为先决条件，以…为前提§The construction of this project presupposes that flexible money will be available during the following months.§该项目开工的前提是在接下来的几个月里要有活动资金。
22541§recapture§ˌriːˈkæptʃə(r)§vt. 重获，收复§Their attempt to recapture the city was failed by a traitor.§他们重新夺回这座城市的企图被一个叛徒毁掉了。
22542§contrive§kənˈtraɪv§v. 计划，图谋；设计；发明§She finds it more difficult to contrive to live as prices are rising every month.§物价每月都在上涨，她觉得越来越难维持生计了。
22543§anticipation§ænˌtɪsɪˈpeɪʃn§n. 预料§According to the anticipation of economists, the global economy will get a burst growth in the second quarter of 2030.§据经济学家预测，全球经济在2030年第二季度将会迎来突破性增长。
22544§provenance§ˈprɒvənəns§n. 出处，起源§According to the theory of Sigmund Freud, the author of this book searched for some doubtful provenance of jealousy.§根据西格蒙德·弗罗伊德的理论，本书作者寻找产生嫉妒的可能原因。
22545§studious§ˈstjuːdiəs§adj. 好学的，学习勤勉的；专心的；谨慎的，认真的，仔细的§The belief of “Learning to be Studious” drives him to enter China's most famous university.§“勤学苦练”这个信仰一直鞭策着他，直到进入中国最好的大学。
22546§vibrant§ˈvaɪbrənt§adj. 振动的；活泼的，充满生气的；兴奋的§Learning memory systems, mental sports and juggling are all wonderful ways to maintain a vibrant, lively mind.§学习记忆系统、脑力运动和杂耍都是保持大脑活力的好方法。
22547§inventive§ɪnˈventɪv§adj. 发明的，创造的；善于发明创造的§This experiment aims to explore children's imagination and inventive learning skill.§该实验的目的在于开发孩子们的想象力和创造性学习技巧。
22548§protrude§prəˈtruːd§v. （使）伸出；（使）突出§The climber tried to hang on to a piece of rock protruding from the cliff face.§攀岩者设法抓住悬崖外突出的岩石。
22549§managerial§ˌmænəˈdʒɪəriəl§adj. 经理的；管理的，经营的§Such systems emphasize the managerial communications function and can be operated easily.§这些系统强调管理通信功能，便于操作。
22550§notoriety§ˌnəʊtəˈraɪəti§n. 声名狼藉，臭名昭著§Even though you quit, that kind of notoriety will still follow you from one workplace to another.§即使你辞职了，这样的恶名还是一样跟着你，从一个岗位到另一个岗位。
22551§opaque§əʊˈpeɪk§adj. 不透明的；晦涩的，难懂的§His paper, with opaque cases, made the tutor dizzy.§他论文中晦涩难懂的案例让导师感到头晕目眩。
22552§partial§ˈpɑːʃl§adj. 部分的，不完全的；偏爱的，癖好的；偏向一方的，偏心的§Parents should not be partial to any one of their children.§父母不该对某个孩子偏心。
22553§ape§eɪp§n. 猿，类人猿 vt. 模仿§It is pretty well agreed that apes and men come from a common ancestor.§人们普遍认为类人猿和人类有共同的祖先。
22554§portable§ˈpɔːtəbl§adj. 便于携带的；手提式的§A quiver is a portable case for holding arrows.§箭囊是可以随身携带的用来装箭的盒子。
22555§depart§dɪˈpɑːt§vi. 离开，起程，出发§Tom departs at sundown to fishing.§汤姆黄昏时分出发去捕鱼。
22556§gauge§geɪdʒ§n. 测量仪表；规格，标准；计量器 vt. 测量，度量§These new monitors can gauge the exhaust from a passing vehicle.§这些新的监视器可以测量驶过车辆的尾气排放量。
22557§dialect§ˈdaɪəlekt§n. 方言，土语§The tourists were confused by the unfamiliar dialects in this area.§游客被该地不熟悉的方言弄得满头雾水。
22558§debate§dɪˈbeɪt§n./v. 争论，辩论§There's a debate in the meeting room about next year's budget.§会议室里（大家）就来年的预算产生了争论。
22559§cosmopolitan§ˌkɒzməˈpɒlɪtən§adj. 世界性的，全球的n. 世界主义者；四海为家者§A port will make a city cosmopolitan.§港口会让一座城市走向世界。
22560§helix§ˈhiːlɪks§n. 螺旋（形）；螺旋状物§The DNA molecule is a double helix, resembling a ladder that's been twisted along its height.§DNA分子是双螺旋结构，就像是顺其长度螺旋扭转的梯子。
22561§motion§ˈməʊʃn§n. 运动；手势 v. （向…）打手势§For years Newton had been curious about the cause of the orbital motion of the moon and planets.§多年来，牛顿一直对月球和行星轨道运动的成因好奇。
22562§understanding§ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ§n. 理解；谅解 adj. 体谅的；宽容的§The Human Genome Project will open up new understanding of many ailments that afflict humanity.§人类基因工程将开启人们对于困扰人类的很多疾病的全新认识。
22563§circumstance§ˈsɜːkəmstəns§n. 环境；[pl.] 境况，情况§In social circumstances, dress has often been used as a sign of professional role.§在社交圈内，服装通常被看作是某种职业角色的标志。
22564§temper§ˈtempə(r)§n. 情绪；脾气 vt. 使缓和§It is generally believed that tempers grow shorter in hot, muggy weather.§人们普遍认为在闷热的天气里更容易发脾气。
22565§insurance§ɪnˈʃʊərəns§n. 保险；保险费；保险业§I'd like to get insurance for the contents of my home.§我想给我家的财物上保险。
22566§impress§ɪmˈpres§vt. 给…留下深刻印象，使铭记；印，压印 n. 印记§Those uniforms for the military were originally intended to impress and even terrify the enemy.§最初设计军装是为了给敌人留下深刻的印象，甚至威慑敌人。
22567§maintain§meɪnˈteɪn§vt. 维持，保持；维修，保养；坚持，主张；赡养，负担§Health promotion programs and policies would help people maintain healthy behaviors and lifestyles.§健康促进计划和方针能够帮助人们保持健康的生活习惯和生活方式。
22568§meaningful§ˈmiːnɪŋfl§adj. 有目的的；有意义的§§

22569§exist§ɪgˈzɪst§vi. 存在；生存§Two American brain researchers studied the brains of human embryos and discovered that the left-right asymmetry exists before birth.§两名美国大脑研究人员研究了人类胚胎的大脑后发现，大脑的左右半球不对称在婴儿出生前就已存在。
22570§jostle§ˈdʒɒsl§v. 推挤；挤开通路；争夺§In a port city, races, cultures, and ideas, as well as goods from a variety of places, jostle, mix and enrich each other.§在港口城市，种族、文化和理念还有那些来自四面八方的货物，互相推挤、混合又互为补充。
22571§version§ˈvɜːʃn§n. 样式，型号，种类；（从不同角度的）说法，描述；（电影、剧本、乐曲等的）版本§This scene was cut from the final version of the movie.§那部电影的最终版本把这场戏删掉了。
22572§hostility§hɒˈstɪləti§n. 敌意，敌对，对抗；抵制，反对，否决；[pl.] 交战，战争§The hostility of the indigenous population to North American influences is still very strong.§当地人对来自北美的影响仍怀有很深的敌意。
22573§appearance§əˈpɪərəns§n. 出现；外观§His sudden appearance surprised me greatly.§他的突然出现让我大吃一惊。
22574§grind§graɪnd§v. 磨碎，碾碎；把…磨光，把…磨锋利 n. 苦差事§Tension may cause you to chew too forcefully or grind your teeth when you are sleeping.§紧张可能导致你在睡觉时用力咀嚼或是磨牙。
22575§optimistic§ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk§adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的§Psychologists have conducted studies showing that people become more optimistic when the weather is sunny.§心理学家已进行的研究表明，人们在阳光灿烂的日子里会更加乐观。
22576§tense§tens§adj. （令人）紧张的；（身体或肌肉）绷紧的 v. （使）绷紧§When pain strikes, we attempt to keep the back as immobile as possible，which makes the muscles tense up.§当疼痛来袭时，我们尽最大努力保持背部不动，这样会使肌肉紧绷。
22577§ignore§ɪgˈnɔː(r)§vt. 不顾，不理，忽视，忽略§If you ignore these instructions, this medicine could affect your heart rhythm.§如果你没有按说明服药，这种药可能会影响你的心率。
22578§extract§ˈekstrækt§n. 摘录，选段；提取物，精，汁[ɪkˈstrækt] vt. 取出；提取；选取§You will hear an extract from a BBC television program on acid rain.§你将会听到一段来自BBC电视节目的有关酸雨的片段。

22579§therefore§ˈðeəfɔː(r)§adv. 因此，所以§The earth is unique, therefore, we have to attain a sustainable balance between population, economic growth and the environment.§我们只有一个地球，因此必须保持人口数量、经济发展与环境之间的长久平衡。

22580§bar§bɑː(r)§n. 酒吧；栅栏；棒，条状物 vt. 闩（门、窗等）；阻拦§Architects in the 18th and 19th centuries began to create buildings by using steel, glass and concrete strengthened steel bars.§18、19世纪的建筑师开始使用钢铁、玻璃和混凝土加固的钢条来建造房屋。
22581§externally§ɪkˈstɜːnəli§adv. 外部地；外表上，外形上§The medicine is used externally only.§这种药只能外用。
22582§abound§əˈbaʊnd§vi. 富于；充满§The mountain streams abound with fish.§山溪里有许多鱼。
22583§subjective§səbˈdʒektɪv§adj. 主观（上）的§Taste and smell were subjective senses.§味觉和嗅觉都是主观感觉。
22584§particularly§pəˈtɪkjələli§adv. 特别，尤其§Mary was particularly fond of bananas.§玛丽特别爱吃香蕉。
22585§quiver§ˈkwɪvə(r)§v. 颤抖，抖动§The moth quivered its wings in front of the fire.§蛾子在火堆前抖动着翅膀。
22586§classification§ˌklæsɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§n. 分类；级别§The classification and analysis of this species occupied scientists for years.§科学家们花费了数年的时间对该物种进行分类和分析。
22587§pollution§pəˈluːʃn§n. 污染；污染物§Air pollution is increasingly becoming the focus of government and citizen concern around the globe.§大气污染正逐渐成为全球范围内政府和市民所关注的焦点。
22588§obtain§əbˈteɪn§v. 获得，得到；通用，流行§Today fibre optics are used to obtain a clearer image of smaller objects.§现在，纤维光学被用于获取较小物体的更清晰图像。
22589§mandarin§ˈmændərɪn§n. 柑橘；政界要员；[M-] 普通话§Which language would you like to learn? We offer French, Italian, Chinese （Mandarin）, Spanish and Portuguese.§您想学习哪种语言？我们提供法语、意大利语、中文（普通话）、西班牙语和葡萄牙语的学习。
